description: 公共施設一覧(自治体標準オープンデータセット [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 4 publishers. Its tags are 行政_財政_選挙. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-04-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
